title: Project list (laptop, written by a person)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\projects.json (D54, D55, D91): the projects that may have a host made, each with the date Terry approved it, and from v0.12 the platforms each MAY have a host made on, each with the date Terry approved it (D91, Q21). Written by a person, read by the driver and the operator, and never added to by agentspace on its own. It governs only making a host: a project that has a host on a platform in hosts.json is placed on that platform whether the list approves it or not. A missing file lists nothing. Strict like the contract's output schemas: anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). A file in which two entries share a name is not valid, though this schema cannot refuse it. A program before v0.12 refuses an entry holding platforms, so v0.12's programs MUST be installed together (D91); the version stays 0, since an older reader refuses such a file rather than misreading it. See docs/state.md, "The project list".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

name.description: The normalized project name, in the lease contract's form.

approved.description: The date Terry approved the project, as YYYY-MM-DD.

platforms.description: From v0.12 (D91, D101; architect, 2026-11-26, for v0.12-T01, pin P4): the whole list of platforms the project MAY have a host made on, each with the date Terry approved it. When present, linux/arm64 is approved only if it is listed. Absent means linux/arm64 alone, approved on the entry's approved, which is what every entry before v0.12 is. At least one item. Two items naming one platform make the file not valid, as two entries of one name do: this schema refuses two equal items (uniqueItems), and two items naming linux/arm64, linux/amd64 or windows/amd64, the platforms v0.12 supports (D98), by maxContains, but cannot refuse two naming any other platform with different dates, since JSON Schema cannot compare two items' members; docs/state.md's text covers them. A platform agentspace does not support MAY be listed, a platform with a variant included (pin P21), and approving it has no effect. Written after approved.

approval.description: One platform's approval: the platform, then the date Terry approved it for the project. No other member is allowed.

platform.description: The normalized platform approved, by the lease's normalized platform pattern, its form and not a list (pin P4).

approved.description: The date Terry approved this platform for the project, as YYYY-MM-DD, the form of the entry's approved.

platform.description: A normalized platform, os/arch[/variant], by the lease's normalized platform pattern: its pattern and not are those of the platform $def of leases.state.schema.json and lease.output.schema.json, word for word (architect, 2026-11-26, for v0.12-T01, pin P4): lowercase, with aarch64 written arm64 and the arm64 variant v8 dropped. A form, not a list: v0.12 supports linux/arm64, linux/amd64 and windows/amd64 alone, compared exactly, so a platform with a variant is unsupported (pin P21).
